description: Western Province - Delegation of Powers under Co-operative Societies Statute of Western Provincial Council No. 03 of 1998
categorisation: This gazette contains both a named individual (Roshan Goonetileke, Governor of the Western Province) and detailed delegation of specific powers and responsibilities to other named officials (Assistant Commissioners) under the Co-operative Societies Statute. It includes both "who" (government personnel) and "what" (detailed portfolio responsibilities and legal powers being delegated), making it a Hybrid Gazette.
